entries.zh: 在；表处所、时间的“在”，兼“在第一”（居首、首先）之义
entries.en: at, in (to be at); the first, in the first place

entries.zh: 预；预先、事先（引申亦作“预闻、参与”解）
entries.en: first; beforehand, in advance (to anticipate)

entries.zh: 第；序数第一之“第”，亦指等第、品第（次第高低）
entries.en: first (ordinal prefix); rank, order of precedence

entries.zh: 旦；元旦，一年的头一天；亦指天亮、破晓
entries.en: dawn, daybreak; the first day of the year (New Year's Day)

entries.zh: 前；在前、先前（时间或位次居先）
entries.en: before, in front; previously, first

entries.zh: 监；监管、监临（原件残缺，或指官职品级之首）
entries.en: to supervise, oversee; supervisory office or rank (first grade of mandarin; text damaged)
entries.notes: 原件残缺：M 栏 “cam seuy” 之后文字残损，仅据 H 栏“监”与西文“官职品级”义暂拟监管、职衔之义，存疑。

entries.zh: 解；乡试第一名之称（解元）；亦指解开、释放、解送
entries.en: first place in the provincial (licentiate) examination; also to untie, release, escort

entries.zh: 武状元；武科考试的第一名
entries.en: first place in the military examination (wu zhuangyuan)

entries.zh: 榜首；榜首，榜单或科考之第一名
entries.en: top of the list, first place (on the examination roll)

entries.zh: 解元；乡试第一名
entries.en: jieyuan: first place in the provincial examination

entries.zh: 排头；排头，队列之首，次序居首
entries.en: head of the line, first in order

entries.zh: 第一；第一，序数之首
entries.en: first, the very first

entries.zh: 监生；国子监的学生（明代监生，亦可由捐纳取得资格）
entries.en: jiansheng: student of the Imperial Academy (National University)

entries.zh: 在先；先前、早先，起初
entries.en: previously, at first, beforehand

entries.zh: 初一；每月（阴历）第一天
entries.en: the first day of the (lunar) month

entries.zh: 初旬；上旬，每月前十日
entries.en: the first ten-day period (xun) of the month

entries.zh: 从来；从来、向来，自始以来（兼有“先前”义）
entries.en: always, from the first (hitherto); before, previously

entries.zh: 原先；原先、最初
entries.en: originally, at first, formerly

entries.zh: 第品；品第、官品等级（居首之品级）
entries.en: rank and grade of dignity; grade of the first rank

entries.zh: 表兄弟；表兄表弟，姑、舅、姨所生之兄弟辈（表亲兄弟）
entries.en: cousins (primo hermano): male cousins on the maternal or affinal side

entries.zh: 表亲；中表之亲（姑表、舅表、姨表亲属），泛指表亲
entries.en: biao kin: cousin on the father's/maternal side, second cousin, cousin in the absolute sense
